title: Shadowfang Keep
body: Shadowfang Keep crowns the heights above Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine. It was the seat of Baron Silverlaine until the worgen loosed on the forest laid siege to it, and the keep fell into shadow and ruin. Now it belongs to the archmage Arugal, who brought them. He keeps to the top of its tower, the worgen he calls his sons prowl its halls, and the ghosts of its servants, guardsmen and officers still walk the rooms they kept in life.

parts.body: The Forsaken sent two deathstalkers in to spy out the keep ahead of an assault. A ward of Arugal's gave them away: Adamant was thrown in a cell, and Vincent was found dead.

title: The Cells
body: Just inside the keep's gate a row of barred cells serves Arugal as a prison, kept by a worgen called Rethilgore. Three prisoners wait behind the bars. Ashcrombe is a sorcerer the Kirin Tor sent to learn how Arugal's war on the undead was going, never guessing the wizard had lost his mind. Adamant is a Forsaken deathstalker, and Landen Stilwell begs to be left alone before his sickness takes him again.

parts.body: Landen Stilwell is a smith, curious enough to have smuggled a crate of the Blood Knights' bloodforged ingots into the keep before he was taken, and no one knows where he hid it.

title: The Courtyard
body: Past the cells a door opens on the courtyard at the heart of the keep. Moonwalkers prowl the yard, the spirits of the keep's servants drift through it, and fel steeds stand in the stables at its far end. Off the yard lies the kitchen, where a worgen butcher holds sway, and beyond it the great hall and the floors above.

parts.body: Jordan Stilwell, now a smith in Ironforge, lived in Pyrewood before the plague and learned the secret of steel in this keep. Fleeing, he left his father's hammer in the stables.

title: Baron Silverlaine
body: Baron Silverlaine was lord of Shadowfang Keep when the worgen came to Silverpine. They besieged his home until it fell, and he did not live through it. His ghost keeps to the great hall, where the shades of his servants still drift, and it is said that his vengeful spirit haunts Arugal himself.

parts.body: His garrison stands to its duty still. Its commander, Springvale, holds the upper floor among the ghosts of his guardsmen, and the Light still answers the dead paladin's call.

title: Archmage Arugal
body: Arugal was an archmage of the Kirin Tor who summoned the worgen to fight the Scourge, and when they turned on the living his mind broke. He took Shadowfang Keep, calls the worgen his children, and keeps to the topmost chamber of its tower behind his great wolf Fenrus and the wolf master Nandos. Those who reach him find a madman, and his curse can make a worgen of anyone who faces him.

parts.body: The Book of Ur, found in the keep, describes the worgen as beasts of a dark place of nightmare, drawn into this world only by powerful magic. Ur hoped no wizard of Dalaran would ever seek them out.
